notes.title: Nymphomaniac - new game with Vydija
notes.content:
Hell(o)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/961e3d291395f4407033c1f2564c3976d034c3c9.jpg[/img]

Introducing Nymphomaniac, an innovative game with unique gameplay mechanics focused on risk management and social interaction, coming soon in Early Access formula!

A visually stunning story about a nymphomaniac who loves her body, sex and adrenaline. All this presented in a photorealistic audiovisual setting. 

(Adult only:)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002570/Nymphomaniac__Sex_Addict/

Our nymphomaniac is tormented by nightmarish visions of [b]HELL[/b] full of succubi and blood. 
Relaxing at home and having sex help her de-stress and get rid of thoughts of possession.

Nymphomaniac is a combination of eroticism, thriller and relaxation game. It's up to the player whether they want to just spend another day relaxing with Vydiya, or whether they want to risk leaving the apartment or meeting a stranger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33887493/3ac7cba6578fb0354a5bd6818dbbff00b34fb975.jpg[/img]

If you want to know more about the project, check out the recording of our last livestream, where we talk about Nymphomaniac in detail (56 min).

[previewyoutube=i59sdCaON0g;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i59sdCaON0g[/previewyoutube]

Please add the game to your wishlist! 



Best regards,
Madmind Studio

notes.title: Your Succubus Neighbor!
notes.content:
[b]Your beloved Succubus Vydija is back![/b]

Our new horror game - "Paranoid," is a part of "The World of Agony." This means that the game's story unfolds in the same universe.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/946920/PARANOID/

Today, we want to share with you the news that your favorite demon - Vydija, will play an important role in the story told in "Paranoid"!
If you loved her in "Agony" and "Succubus," now you'll have the opportunity to explore her darker side...

[previewyoutube=VUb53LVzzQI;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Is your neighbor... a demon? [/b]

Among all the crazy theories that the main character is living with, this one seems to be the most true. Could the neighbor who haunts Patrick's dreams be hiding a dark secret? Who is she really, and why can't he get her out of his head? Does she even exist, and do we really want to know the answer to that question?

The protagonist, suffering from Paranoid Schizophrenia, will have to make a difficult decision – whether to stay at home without medication and uncover the dark secret of his neighbor? Or should he buy the medicine and go to meet his missing sister, who, for the first time in ten years, has given a sign of life?
"Paranoid" will allow players to determine the course of Patryk's story. Depending on the choices made, the player will either lock themselves in their apartment with their own demons or venture into the city, discovering an alternative course of events. The game can be completed in two ways, showing how the simple decision to stay or leave the apartment profoundly affects the protagonist's fate.
Both game paths are equally significant and rich in content.


The full version of the game will be released on [b]December 15, 2023![/b]

Stay Hot!

/ Madmind

notes.title: Agony: Lords of Hell - Demo available now!
notes.content:
Hello, Martyrs!

We are pleased to announce that we're releasing the Agony: Lords of Hell demo on Steam, which will remain active until the end of the Kickstarter campaign. The demo contains a fragment of the game, in Alpha version 0.666 and is available globally, for [b]all Steam users - not just for Kickstarter backers[/b].

We invite you to play through and complete the feedback survey present in the demo. Based on the collected answers, we'll be able to better tailor the game to the expectations of you, the players. 

The completely different visions of Hell, which can be found in the books of individual Religions, will require the preparation of many assets, unique mechanics for each of the "factions", dozens of new characters and beautiful scenery. To achieve our vision, we need your support!

Thanks to the Kickstarter campaign, we will not only be able to fulfill our ambitious plans, but also enable players to decide how big and how extensive the Agony Lords of Hell project will be. 

The game is powered by [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b], supporting all the latest technologies, including the destruction of the environment based on the "Chaos" technology, a dynamic day and night system, the Niagara system and many more.

[b]We hope you enjoy the demo, and look forward to seeing you in hell![/b]

[previewyoutube=XrpfqR6gkyk;full][/previewyoutube]

Completely different visions of Hell, which can be found in the books of individual religions, will require the preparation of many assets, unique mechanics for each of the factions, dozens of new characters and beautiful scenery. To achieve our vision, we need your support.

Thanks to the Kickstarter campaign, we will not only be able to fulfil our ambitious plans, but we will also enable players to decide how big and how extensive the Agony Lords of Hell project will be. 

The game is powered by[b] Unreal Engine 5[/b], supporting all the latest technologies, including the destruction of the environment based on the "Chaos" technology, a dynamic day and night system, the Niagara system and many more.


See you in hell :)

notes.title: AGONY: Lords of Hell
notes.content:
[b]Dear Martyrs,[/b]

[b]AGONY: Lords of Hell[/b] is a new title from the World of Agony, for which the newly created internal team of Madmind Studio - Team Alpha is responsible. The team's task, apart from producing the new game, will also be supporting Succubus in the form of free updates and paid DLC in 2022.

Agony and Agony UNRATED have already reached almost 800,000 players around the world. The players’ appreciation prompted us to release Succubus, a game that was set in the Agony universe, continuing and developing some of the plot and lore. Agony: Lords of Hell [b]shows the events that took place between Agony and Succubus[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/8d24d7b67f23532297322dfef89f9d9efb39bdd1.jpg[/img]

The story of the game will tell about the fate of the main characters of Agony and Succubus - king Nimrod and Vydija, a demonic succubus. With the departure of the rightful rulers of Hell, [b]a war for the throne broke out[/b]. The lords of hell, ruling over different lands, begin to gather armies of demons to slay the rulers who threatened them. Our heroes will be forced not only to maintain their current position, but also to expand their empire and conquer the enemy territories.

The main inspiration for the gameplay in Agony: Lords of Hell is the iconic Populous series. While the main character of the game - Nimrod, will focus on developing the city and managing the army, the demonic Vydijia will become the main unit controlled by the player. With numerous combat skills and special powers, Vydija will lead Nimrod's army to victory, and will be the key strategic element of every battle. Thanks to her high position among other succubi, Vydija will use her abilities to seduce and then incorporate martyrs, who do not belong to any of the factions, into her own army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/f04f463a66365acc5ded0b7418eff49179f646f8.jpg[/img]

Similar to Agony, we want players to be able to decide about the scale of Agony: Lords of Hell project. In 2022, players from around the world will be able to support this ambitious project using the Kickstarter crowdfunding platform. During the planned crowdfundning, players will decide how extensive Agony: Lords of Hell will be. A demo version of the game will be available to players supporting the game, which will allow them to get to know its unique world, full of dangers, horrors and ... Strategy!

The first trailer of the game will be presented [b]on December 16, 2021, during MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase[/b].

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Madmind Studio
